rulebook_source:
rulebook_id: claims-gate
version: 1.0.0
adopted_at: "2026-08-05T00:00:00Z"
description: >
  Insurance claims workflow gate: auto-approval only under declared authority, fresh
  documentation, and coverage; everything unsettled escalates instead of guessing.
track: [claim_id, adjuster_id]
evidence:
  - {id: coverage, source: http, ref: "https://api.internal.example/coverage", max_age_seconds: 3600}
  - {id: docs_complete, source: file, ref: ./claim/docs-manifest.json, max_age_seconds: 86400}
  - {id: authority_limit, source: file, ref: ./claim/authority.json, max_age_seconds: 604800}
rules:
  - id: over-authority
    when: 'candidate.action.params.amount > evidence.authority_limit'
    outcome: HOLD
    reason: Amount exceeds this adjuster's declared authority; route to named escalation.
  - id: coverage-denies
    when: 'fresh(coverage) and evidence.coverage == "excluded"'
    outcome: BLOCK
    reason: Coverage determination excludes this claim category. This is a denial, not an unknown.
  - id: auto-approve-in-authority
    when: 'fresh(coverage) and evidence.coverage == "covered" and present(docs_complete) and candidate.action.params.amount <= evidence.authority_limit'
    outcome: ALLOW
    reason: Covered, documented, within declared authority.
default_outcome: HOLD
authorization: {ttl_seconds: 600, single_use: true}

reasons.message: Amount exceeds this adjuster's declared authority; route to named escalation.
